stages.name: Stage 5 – Present (Gelifluction / Sorting)
stages.description: Freeze-thaw cycles sort boulders by size

stages.name: Stage 4 – Rounding (Woolsack Weathering)
stages.description: Acidic groundwater rounds the sharp edges

stages.name: Stage 3 – Fracturing (Cooling Joints / Diaclasas)
stages.description: Thermal contraction cracks the rock into blocks

stages.name: Stage 2 – Pluton Formation
stages.description: Magma cools and crystallises slowly underground

stages.name: Stage 1 – Magma Generation (Subduction)
stages.description: Partial melting of mantle and crust produces magma

pinch.name: During Pinch Interaction (Collision)
pinch.description: Continental collision forces one plate beneath another
